title: Tilia
summary: A research codebase for a CIKM 2025 paper enhancing LIME explanations with decision-tree surrogates, including a competitor baseline (CALIME/faster_lime) and tabular plausibility metrics. The competitor's tabular explainer directly imports and fits a CTGANSynthesizer to generate synthetic samples, and a plausibility-metrics module imports evaluation functions from sdv.metrics.tabular, so SDV's CTGAN and metrics modules are run only as part of baseline comparison code, not the paper's own method.
needs: Unclear whether sdv.metrics.tabular functions in plausibility.py are actually invoked elsewhere in that file; only the import line is captured.
